biocrates’ team of experts is highly professional, the analytical team is meticulous and
knowledgeable about their workflow from sample prep to data analysis. The data analysis solutions
brought me the efficiency and enabled me to focus on result interpretation for my research program.
I am confident in continuing work with the biocrates team for my discoveries in future studies. 

**Ru Wei, PhD**
Scientific Director, Proteomics, Chemical Biology & Proteomics, Biogen USA

One challenge we face in clinical research is the limitation of the number of precious samples and
the unique nature of each sample. It can be difficult to acquire matched controls for every study.
We tested the QMDB and the various filter options matched well to study groups and the results
aligned with our control groups. Reassurance by the QMDB helped us to verify that our results were
within normal ranges and provide further power to our study.

**Teodoro Bottiglieri, PhD**
Director of Research, Center of Metabolomics; Baylor Scott & White Research Institute, USA

Our institute was looking for a standardized and validated approach to further expand our
metabolomics portfolio. In general, LC-MS-based methods lack comparability and robustness. In
addition, most self-developed or commercially available targeted approaches do not cover a broad
spectrum of metabolites. Therefore, we use the MxP® Quant 500 XL kit on a routine base as a
certified lab, because it is the most comprehensive solution for quantitative results on small
molecules and lipids and complementary to our NMR-based metabolomics panel.

**Dr. Sven Schuchardt**
Head of Bio- and Environmental Analytics, Fraunhofer ITEM – Institute of Toxicology and Experimental
Medicine, Germany

Our Metabolomics Core is involved in many long-term projects. Such projects require the generation
of reliable and comparable data over a long period of time, so data quality is of paramount
importance to us. We rely on the biocrates platform’s high-quality workflow and data analysis
pipeline, which helped us eliminate variability and generate reproducible data. Their technology has
also proven to be highly versatile and we could generate amazing insights in different indications
using a wide spectrum of sample matrices (e.g. biofluids, tissues, cells). Therefore, I highly
recommend the biocrates platform to any researcher looking to improve their data quality or just
getting started in metabolomics.

**Dr. Gernot Poschet**
Executive Director, Metabolomics Core Technology Platform, Heidelberg University & German Cancer

# Biogenity

Your Global Partner in Omics

## Welcome to Biogenity

Biogenity is Contract Research Organisation specializing in omics research and discovery.

Biogenity provides a wide range of services for your omics research study. We facilitate every step
from sample preparation to mass spectrometry, data analysis, and interpretation of biological
findings with our complete coverage omics workflows.

If you’d like to learn more, we are happy to discuss your project and help you get the most out of
your omics analysis.

[Let’s discuss your project][1]

### Biogenity is partnering with

[DTU] [Eximious] [TAmiRNA]

## Biogenity's services for omics research

### Omics discovery services

##### Proteomics

Explore our different tailored workflows and discover new insights.

[Learn more][2]

##### Transcriptomics

Investigate the biological systems with Biogenity's complete workflows for RNA.

[Learn more][3]

##### Metabolomics

Discover metabolomic changes or measure the concentration of your targeted metabolites.

[Learn more][4]

##### Multiomics

Tap into system biology and discover how we can assist you in mapping biological mechanisms.

[Learn more][5]

### Data analysis services

##### Data cleaning and visualization

Benefit from Biogenity's team of specialists ready to process raw data into meaningful data.

[Learn more][6]

##### Statistical analysis

Check out our DEMO report or book an online meeting with a data scientist.

[Learn more][7]

##### Bioinformatical analysis

Discovery of how to turn data into biology with Biogenity's powerful tools.

[Learn more][8]

##### AI powered data analysis

Explore AI in diagnostic models and explainable AI in biomarker discovery.

[Learn more][9]

##### Peptide and protein annotation

Benefit from validating or discovering the peptides and proteins in your data.

[Learn more][10]

## Latest news

### We are hiring an Omics Scientist/Scientific Customer Consulting

August 7, 2025 | By Louis Loeb

We are seeking a new colleague to join us in supporting scientists from various industries,
including pharmaceutical, biotech, food technology, and academia, in their omics research projects.
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated individual with a passion for Omics and customer
consulting. The role requires you have experience within at least one of following areas:
transcriptomics, metabolomes or proteomics. This includes knowledge of sample requirements,
different approaches to sample analysis, and hands-on experience with data interpretation and
analysis. You also need to be experienced R user, as the work include execution, optimization and
development of analytical pipelines in R or python.

[Read the job advert][11] [More news][12]

### Plant a tree with Biogenity

Biogenity donates a dozen trees for every project delivered to support local communities,
reforestation in the Amazon rainforest, and reduce CO2 emissions. See [how we are making a
difference][13] together.

Biogenity © | All Rights Reserved

subcellular resolution

### Metagenomics

Unlock the full potential of microbiome research with our advanced Metagenomic Sequencing services,
part of our global NGS and multi omics services portfolio. By sequencing all DNA present in a
sample, our metagenomics provides high‑resolution microbiome analysis services across multiple
species in complex microbial communities, enabling precise detection of microbial species,
functional potential, antimicrobial resistance, and virulence factors while minimizing false
positives through robust pipelines and quality controls.

This untargeted approach supports functional analysis and systems biology by linking microbial
species and AMR genes to health outcomes and interventions in clinical microbiomics and microbiome
studies.

[ [Fluorescent microscopy image with cellular structures in red and blue] ][111]
 

## Metabolomics

Our dedicated metabolomics team offers a comprehensive range of services to meet your needs,
accommodating both novices and experienced researchers. Collaborate directly with our specialized
scientists in metabolomics and molecular biology for guidance on analytical techniques, method
selection, technical analysis details, and advanced data analysis and interpretation of metabolite
profiling.

Tailored to your specific requirements, our metabolomics platforms offer both untargeted and
targeted metabolomics analyses that integrate with metagenomics and other omics data to reveal
functional potential and health outcomes in human health, animal health, and global health
applications.

## How researchers use our products

Our products power breakthroughs across diverse fields, from cancer research and immunology to
neuroscience and developmental biology, enabling scientists to see biology at unprecedented
resolution.
Pharma

### Stacking the odds for greater drug development success

Drug development is one of science’s toughest gambles, with nearly 90% of candidates failing to pass
trials. Our technologies reveal how diseases develop and respond to treatment, empowering the
advancement of high-impact therapies with confidence.

[Discover how single cell is advancing cell therapy for melanoma][16]
Oncology

### Leaving cancer with nowhere to hide

Tumors adapt, resist, and hide from treatment with clever biological tricks. By illuminating these
hidden strategies, our technologies give researchers the clarity to outsmart cancer with a new
generation of therapies.

[See how spatial is reshaping what we know about tumor response][17]
Immunology

### Turning chaos into breakthrough therapies

The immune system shapes our health in powerful ways, good and bad. Our tools uncover how immune
cells fine-tune defense responses and why, in some cases, they misfire. These discoveries will lead
to treatments that help us control our immune system so it works for us, not against us.

[Read how Allen Institute studied over 16 million single immune cells][18]

From billions of cells to massive tissue collections, accurate AI cell models demand more than just
data. They require the best data. Our technologies deliver the quality needed to build trustworthy
virtual cells that accelerate discovery and drug development.

opportunities for treatment beyond pulmonary and respiratory diseases. We also explore the
challenges of nose-to-brain delivery, next-generation propellants, overcoming the limitations of dry

[Featured Articles][19]

diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

[Featured Articles][37]

[28]: https://www.evotec.com/solutions/just-evotec-biologics # Pioneering Drug Discovery

We are a life science company that is pioneering the future of drug discovery and preclinical
development. We strive for technology and science leadership in everything we do. Together with our
partners, we accelerate the journey from concept to cure by leveraging cutting-edge technology,
disruptive science, and extensive disease knowledge.

[Learn More][1]

We accelerate the discovery and development of life-changing medicines by focusing on scientific
excellence coupled with deep disease understanding and proprietary next-gen technology platforms.
Working across modality, our expertise spans from small molecules to biotherapeutics. Through Just –
Evotec Biologics, we have revolutionized the design, development, and manufacturing of biologics,
making high-quality therapies more accessible and affordable.

Our fully integrated R&D value chain and flexible partnering models deliver unmatched speed,
efficiency, and quality ensuring better treatments reach patients sooner. At Evotec, innovation
isn’t just our heritage - it’s our future.

# Home

## Outpacing
## cancer starts with early detection

Detecting cancer early can make a world of difference. Freenome is setting a new pace for early
cancer detection by combining the latest in science and artificial intelligence, with the ease of a
standard blood draw.

## Outpacing
## cancer starts with early detection

Detecting cancer early can make a world of difference. Freenome is setting a new pace for early
cancer detection by combining the latest in science and artificial intelligence, with the ease of a
standard blood draw.

[Outpacing cancer starts with early detection]

## A novel approach to screening

Freenome’s intelligent screening platform uses multiomics technology to detect cancer in its
earliest, most treatable stages.

[ Our science ][30]

## Powered by a rigorous clinical program

Our research programs drive discovery, development, and validation of our early cancer detection
tests.

[ Learn About Our Studies ][31]
[A doctor having a discussion with a patient]

## Multi-disciplinary leadership with purpose

We bring together passionate creators and ambitious builders. Together, we are relentless in pushing
for what’s possible in early cancer detection.

[ About Us ][32]
[woman in Freenome office lab]

## Join our team

Are you ready to make a significant impact? Explore our job openings and see how your skills can
help us redefine the future of cancer screening.

[ Learn More ][33]

## Outpacing cancer starts with early detection

Cancer screening should be simple, accessible and effective. Freenome is developing blood-based
screening tests designed to detect cancer at its earliest, most treatable stages — helping expand
access to screening through the ease of a standard blood draw.

## Outpacing cancer starts with early detection

Cancer screening should be simple, accessible and effective. Freenome is developing blood-based
screening tests designed to detect cancer at its earliest, most treatable stages — helping expand
access to screening through the ease of a standard blood draw.

## A personalized approach to screening

We believe cancer screening should recognize that every person and every cancer is different. Our
Personalized Cancer Detection approach combines blood-based testing with advanced multiomics to
deliver more individualized, data-driven screening designed to improve accessibility and
performance.

[ Our Approach ][34]

## AI/ML-powered intelligence

Our platform integrates multiomics, artificial intelligence and machine learning to uncover complex
biological signals associated with cancer. By learning from large-scale clinical data, it provides
the scientific foundation for a growing portfolio of blood-based screening tests.
[ Our Technology ][35]

## SimpleScreen: making cancer screening easy and accessible

Freenome’s portfolio of SimpleScreen blood-based screening tests is how we deliver Personalized
Cancer Detection – screening as unique as each individual patient.

Learn more about our SimpleScreen™ CRC, the first offering in what will be an expanding portfolio
designed to address a broad range of patient risks and screening needs

[ Learn more about SimpleScreen ↗ ][36]

## Building the future of early detection

Since our founding in 2014, Freenome has been building the future of early cancer detection by
combining cutting-edge science, advanced AI and machine learning technology, and bold thinking.
Discover the vision, values and team behind Freenome’s mission to change how cancer is detected.

## Outpacing cancer starts with early detection

Cancer screening should be simple, accessible and effective. Freenome is developing blood-based
screening tests designed to detect cancer at its earliest, most treatable stages — helping expand
access to screening through the ease of a standard blood draw.

## A personalized approach to screening

We believe cancer screening should recognize that every person and every cancer is different. Our
Personalized Cancer Detection approach combines blood-based testing with advanced multiomics to
deliver more individualized, data-driven screening designed to improve accessibility and
performance.

biological signals associated with cancer. By learning from large-scale clinical data, it provides
the scientific foundation for a growing portfolio of blood-based screening tests.
